text_block_list.name: Children's Center Staff
text_block_list.text: Both of you, go ahead and eat up! Don't worry about assisting!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'd prefer to do something to help…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, on our way back from a day out, we're approached by some familiar children.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Girl
text_block_list.text: I knew it was you! You're the heroes who helped out Doto!
choice_data_list: Oh, it's the kids from when we were searching for the legendary blade.

text_block_list.name: Children's Center Parent A
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! I heard that you helped Opera O prepare for her performance!

text_block_list.name: Children's Center Parent B
text_block_list.text: The kids seemed so excited saying they couldn't wait to see it. Why don't you join us for a barbecue?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, that's all right. We didn't do anything special.

text_block_list.name: Cheeky-Faced Boy
text_block_list.text: Pleeease! Just for a little while! Come on, this way!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-hold on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite seeming quite hesitant, Admire Vega joins in with the barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Children's Center Staff B
text_block_list.text: Hm? We've already run out of ingredients? I'll have to go and pick up a few more things.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Uh… In that case, I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Children's Center Staff B
text_block_list.text: No, you sit down! You're our guest, and we need to get quite a lot!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We can handle it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This should be everything. I hope so, anyway…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've got a lot of boxes. Even if they aren't too heavy to lift, there's no way we can keep them balanced on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't know how this is going to work. But I said I'd do it, so…
Hey, Ayabe! That's a ton of groceries you've got there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This is where you're heading with those boxes, right? Let's load them onto my cart!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thank you. That… would be a big help.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No worries! You're in luck—I was planning to buy a lot today!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (But obviously she meant to use the cart for herself. I'm making her go really far out of the way…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (We're costing her a lot of time and effort. It wouldn't be enough to only give her a "thank you.")

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Okay, I should start heading back! Have fun, guys!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-wait up!

text_block_list.name: Children's Center Staff A
text_block_list.text: Yes, we can't have you go just like that. Let us treat you to a meal for helping us carry everything! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? In that case… thank you so much! I'll gladly join you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! This makes me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Happy…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't need it. Your words are thanks enough.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-but! I couldn't… How about something besides a drink? An ice cream, or a grilled carrot? Or maybe…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I see…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road… I'll do the cooking. You take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Okay.
choice_data_list: What's up? It looks like something's on your mind.
What's up? It looks like something's on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I think I kind of understand how Doto felt before.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sometimes you want to do something more than just saying thank you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There are feelings that can't be expressed through words alone.
choice_data_list: In that case, you have to do a good job with the cooking!
In that case, you have to do a good job with the cooking!
We really learned a lot today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There are feelings that can't be expressed through words alone.
choice_data_list: In that case, you have to do a good job with the cooking!
In that case, you have to do a good job with the cooking!
We really learned a lot today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That goes for you too. Make sure not to burn anything.

text_block_list.name: Children's Center Staff
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Thanks so much, you two! You did a great job grilling the meat!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Saying it out loud feels a bit embarrassing, though…
choice_data_list: Come on, you don't have be like that!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't start. Just be quiet and eat your food.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega piles vegetables and meat onto my plate in rapid succession, not allowing me a moment to speak.
